texts.name: Murdoch
texts.biography: Murdoch is a man to call a professional soldier of fortune. He barely likes anything more than money and fame. That is why Murdoch gathered a company of daredevils of his own kind and went to seek adventures on the landscapes of Jadame. Who knows where his fate will take him next time?

specialty.name: Archery
specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Archery skill percentage.
